title: Sequelitis - Mega Man Classic vs. Mega Man X
summary: Egoraptor's Sequelitis compares Mega Man Classic and Mega Man X, analyzing how the games teach players through level design without explicit tutorials. It mixes comedy with design analysis.
why: HN commenters use it as the standard example of invisible onboarding and good game design, praising it as funny and insightful.

quote.text: it does make some very very good points about video game design
